title: norminv
summary: Evaluate the inverse normal cumulative distribution function.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until a provider hook exists.

description: `norminv(p)` returns the standard normal quantile. `norminv(p,mu)` and `norminv(p,mu,sigma)` return the quantile for a normal distribution with mean `mu` and standard deviation `sigma`.
behaviors: `p`, `mu`, and `sigma` may be scalars or matching-size numeric arrays.

faqs.question: How is norminv related to erfcinv?
faqs.answer: RunMat computes the normal inverse using the same inverse-complementary-error-function path as `erfcinv`.
